title: Signal in the Ice
setup: The player is a weather station technician at a remote Arctic research outpost. A storm has cut off communication. A distress signal begins broadcasting from an abandoned Soviet-era relay bunker nearby. The story stays grounded around the outpost, the snow trail, the bunker entrance, and the bunker interior.

scenes.title: Outpost: The Signal
scenes.text: The wind screams against the metal walls of Outpost Veyra. The generator lights flicker, and the radio console crackles to life by itself. A repeating emergency signal cuts through the static: “Station Twelve… alive below… do not open the lower door.”
scenes.prompt: Outside, visibility is almost zero. The signal is coming from an old relay bunker less than a kilometer away. Your team is missing, and the storm is getting worse. What do you do?

options.label: Answer the radio
options.response: I try to answer the signal on the radio.

options.label: Gear up
options.response: I prepare my survival gear and head toward the bunker.

options.label: Search the outpost
options.response: I search the outpost for anything useful before leaving.

scenes.title: Radio: The Voice Replies
scenes.text:
You press the transmit button. “This is Outpost Veyra. Identify yourself.”

For a few seconds, only static answers. Then a weak voice whispers, “Do not trust the lights. Follow the maintenance markers. If you see your own footprints ahead of you, turn back.”
scenes.prompt: The signal cuts out. The console screen briefly flashes a map route toward the bunker before going dark. What do you do?

options.label: Follow the map
options.response: I memorize the route and leave for the bunker.

options.label: Check the logs
options.response: I check the radio logs to see when the signal started.

scenes.title: Snow Trail: Into the Storm
scenes.text: You step outside into freezing darkness. The outpost door seals behind you with a heavy clank. Red maintenance poles mark a narrow trail through the snow. Ahead, faint bunker lights blink through the storm.
scenes.prompt: Halfway down the trail, you find fresh footprints crossing yours, but they are headed toward the outpost, not away from it. No one else should be outside. What do you do?

options.label: Follow the poles
options.response: I ignore the footprints and keep following the maintenance poles.

options.label: Follow the footprints
options.response: I follow the footprints to see where they came from.

options.label: Call out
options.response: I call out into the storm and listen for a response.

scenes.title: Outpost Search: The Emergency Locker
scenes.text: You search the outpost quickly. In the emergency locker, you find a flare gun, a thermal scanner, and a cracked ID badge belonging to Dr. Mara Vale, the station lead. Her badge is stained with frozen blood.
scenes.prompt: A message has been scratched into the locker door: “LOWER DOOR NEEDS TWO PEOPLE.” What do you take?

options.label: Take the scanner
options.response: I take the thermal scanner and head outside.

options.label: Take the flare gun
options.response: I take the flare gun and head outside.

options.label: Take the ID badge
options.response: I take Dr. Vale’s ID badge and check the station logs.

scenes.title: Station Logs: The Missing Team
scenes.text:
The station logs show that Dr. Vale and two engineers left for the bunker six hours ago. Their last note says: “The relay bunker has power, but no generator reading. Heat signatures detected below ground. Possible survivors.”

The final entry is only one sentence: “Mara came back, but she is still on the bunker camera.”
scenes.prompt: The outpost lights flicker again. What do you do?

options.label: Leave now
options.response: I leave the outpost before the storm traps me inside.

options.label: View the camera feed
options.response: I open the bunker camera feed.

scenes.title: Bunker Entrance: Frozen Steel
scenes.text:
You reach the bunker entrance. The door is half-buried in ice, but a green access light still glows beside it. Deep scratches cover the metal from the inside, not the outside.

Your radio crackles again. The same voice whispers, “If the door opens easily, run.”
scenes.prompt: The access panel is active. What do you do?

options.label: Open the door
options.response: I use the access panel and open the bunker door.

options.label: Inspect the door
options.response: I inspect the scratches and the door mechanism first.

scenes.title: Snow Trail: The Wrong Footprints
scenes.text:
You follow the footprints away from the maintenance poles. After a few meters, the storm thins strangely, as if the wind is avoiding this patch of ice. The footprints end at a frozen body wearing your exact boots and jacket.

Its face is hidden under frost. Your radio suddenly turns on by itself and broadcasts your own voice: “Don’t look.”
scenes.prompt: What do you do?

options.label: Look at its face
options.response: I wipe the frost away and look at the body’s face.

options.label: Backtrack to the trail
options.response: I back away and return to the maintenance trail.

scenes.title: Snow Trail: Something Answers
scenes.text: You call out. For a moment, the storm goes silent. Then three voices answer from different directions. One sounds like Dr. Vale. One sounds like a child. One sounds exactly like you.
scenes.prompt: The bunker lights blink twice in the distance. The maintenance poles remain visible, but the voices keep calling your name. What do you do?

options.label: Ignore the voices
options.response: I ignore the voices and keep moving toward the bunker.

options.label: Answer Dr. Vale
options.response: I answer the voice that sounds like Dr. Vale.

options.label: Answer your own voice
options.response: I answer the voice that sounds like me.

scenes.title: Camera Feed: Two Maras
scenes.text:
The bunker camera feed loads in broken frames. Dr. Vale stands inside the bunker entrance, staring directly at the camera. Behind her, another Dr. Vale is crawling across the ceiling, moving silently.

The standing Dr. Vale raises a paper sign: “BRING THE BADGE. DO NOT BRING LIGHT.”
scenes.prompt: The feed dies. What do you do?

options.label: Bring the badge
options.response: I take Dr. Vale’s badge and leave for the bunker.

options.label: Turn off the lights
options.response: I shut off the outpost lights before leaving.

scenes.title: Bunker Hall: The Easy Door
scenes.text:
The bunker door slides open without resistance. Warm air spills out. That should be impossible. The hallway inside is lit by clean white lights, and the floor is dry.

At the far end, Dr. Vale stands beside an elevator marked LOWER RELAY. She smiles too widely. “You came alone,” she says. “That makes this easier.”
scenes.prompt: What do you do?

options.label: Approach Dr. Vale
options.response: I approach Dr. Vale and ask what happened.

options.label: Stay back
options.response: I stay near the entrance and refuse to move closer.

options.label: Fire the flare
options.response: I fire the flare gun down the hallway.

scenes.title: Bunker Door: Manual Release
scenes.text: You inspect the door and find the access motor has been bypassed from inside. Someone wanted the door to open easily. Under the ice, you also find a manual locking wheel. If you turn it, the door will open only halfway and stay jammed.
scenes.prompt: That would let you enter, but it would also keep something large from rushing out. What do you do?

options.label: Jam the door
options.response: I turn the wheel and force the door to open only halfway.

options.label: Open the door fully
options.response: I use the access panel and open the door fully.

scenes.title: The Loop
scenes.text:
You wipe the frost from the face. It is yours. Older, frozen, and twisted in terror.

Your radio screams with your own voice: “This is how it learns the way back.”

The ice beneath you cracks. For one second, you see the bunker hallway below the snow, impossibly close. Then the storm swallows you.

Hours later, the radio at Outpost Veyra crackles to life by itself. A new voice begins broadcasting your words.

scenes.title: Snow Trail: False Mara
scenes.text:
You answer the voice that sounds like Dr. Vale. A figure appears between the maintenance poles, walking toward you without disturbing the snow.

“I found a safe way in,” she says. “No need for the main door.”
scenes.prompt: But her shadow points toward the bunker lights, while her body faces you. The real Dr. Vale’s badge in your pocket grows warm. What do you do?

options.label: Follow her
options.response: I follow the figure claiming to be Dr. Vale.

options.label: Show the badge
options.response: I hold up Dr. Vale’s badge and demand proof.

options.label: Run to the bunker
options.response: I run past her toward the bunker entrance.

scenes.title: Outpost Dark: No Light
scenes.text:
You shut off the outpost lights. Darkness drops over the room. Immediately, the radio clears. Dr. Vale’s real voice speaks, weak but steady: “Good. It copies what it sees. Light helps it finish the shape.”

She gives you a code for the bunker’s emergency lock: 7-1-9.

Then she says, “When you reach me, do not open the lower door. Burn the relay instead.”
scenes.prompt: What do you do?

options.label: Memorize the code
options.response: I memorize the code and head to the bunker in darkness.

options.label: Ask about the lower door
options.response: I ask Dr. Vale what is behind the lower door.

scenes.title: Bunker Hall: Too Close
scenes.text:
You approach Dr. Vale. Her smile stretches until the skin at the corners of her mouth splits. Behind her, the elevator doors open onto darkness.

She reaches out and says, “The lower door needs two people. You are the second.”
scenes.prompt: The hallway lights flare bright white. Your shadow on the wall moves before you do. What do you do?

options.label: Pull away
options.response: I pull away and retreat toward the entrance.

options.label: Enter the elevator
options.response: I step into the elevator with her.

scenes.title: Bunker Hall: Holding Distance
scenes.text:
You stay near the entrance. The half-open door groans behind you, jammed just enough to block anything large. Dr. Vale’s expression goes blank.

From somewhere below, a heavy knocking begins. Two knocks. Pause. Two knocks. The elevator doors open by themselves.
scenes.prompt: A bloody handprint appears on the inside wall beside you, fresh and human. What do you do?

options.label: Find the survivor
options.response: I follow the handprints deeper into the side corridor.

options.label: Destroy the relay
options.response: I look for the relay equipment and try to destroy the signal.

options.label: Take the elevator
options.response: I enter the elevator and go down.

scenes.title: Bunker Hall: Flare Light
scenes.text: The flare explodes red down the hallway. For an instant, the clean white walls vanish. You see rust, hanging cables, frozen bodies, and something huge folded behind Dr. Vale like a spider made of people.
scenes.prompt: It shrieks and slams into the walls. The bunker door starts closing. You have seconds. What do you do?

options.label: Escape into the storm
options.response: I dive back outside before the door closes.

options.label: Push toward the relay room
options.response: I push forward through the red flare light toward the relay room.

scenes.title: The Side Entrance
scenes.text:
You follow the false Dr. Vale away from the bunker entrance. She leads you to a narrow hatch buried under snow.

“This way avoids the lower door,” she says.

The moment you climb in, the hatch seals above you. The tunnel walls are warm and wet. The voice behind you changes into your own.

“Thank you for choosing the quiet way.”

The tunnel begins to move.
scenes.endingSummary: You entered through the creature’s mouth.

scenes.title: False Mara Revealed
scenes.text:
You hold up Dr. Vale’s badge. The figure stops. Her face twitches, then forgets how to be human.

The badge emits a weak emergency ping, and the bunker access light turns green in the distance. The false Mara retreats into the storm, copying your footsteps as it goes.
scenes.prompt: You now know the main entrance is your safest route. What do you do?

options.label: Use the main door
options.response: I continue to the bunker’s main entrance.

options.label: Turn back
options.response: I retreat toward the outpost before the storm worsens.

scenes.title: Bunker Entrance: Code Access
scenes.text:
You reach the bunker in darkness. Without the outpost lights behind you, the storm feels quieter. The access panel asks for an emergency code.

You enter 7-1-9. The door opens halfway, then locks itself in place. A message appears on the panel: “CONTAINMENT MODE ACTIVE.”
scenes.prompt: Inside, the hallway is dark except for red emergency strips along the floor. What do you do?

options.label: Enter carefully
options.response: I enter carefully and keep close to the jammed door.

options.label: Scan the hall
options.response: I use the thermal scanner to check the hallway first.

scenes.title: The Truth Below
scenes.text:
Dr. Vale answers after a long pause. “It was not trapped in the bunker. The bunker was built around it.”

She explains that the lower relay door covers an old ice shaft. The signal is not a message. It is bait. The thing below copies voices, faces, and memories, but it needs light and witnesses to complete a copy.

Then the radio hisses: “Mara is almost gone.”
scenes.prompt: What do you do?

options.label: Leave in darkness
options.response: I leave in darkness and use the emergency code at the bunker.

options.label: Stay at the outpost
options.response: I barricade the outpost and refuse to go to the bunker.

scenes.title: The Lower Door
scenes.text:
The elevator descends for much longer than it should. Dr. Vale stands beside you, smiling in the dark reflection of the metal wall.

At the bottom, the doors open to a massive circular vault door covered in frost. Two hand scanners glow beside it.

Your hand rises before you command it. Dr. Vale places hers on the other scanner.

The lower door unlocks. Something ancient exhales beneath the world.

scenes.title: Side Corridor: The Real Dr. Vale
scenes.text:
You follow the bloody handprints into a cramped side corridor. Behind a maintenance grate, you find the real Dr. Vale, injured and freezing.

She is barely conscious. “Relay room,” she whispers. “Burn the core. Then lock me in if I change.”
scenes.prompt: The knocking below becomes faster. The false Dr. Vale is still in the main hall. What do you do?

options.label: Help Dr. Vale
options.response: I help Dr. Vale out and bring her with me.

options.label: Leave Dr. Vale
options.response: I promise to come back and move toward the relay room alone.

scenes.title: Relay Room: The Signal Core
scenes.text:
You reach the relay room. The equipment is ancient but still running. Cables run from the machines down through a sealed floor hatch marked LOWER RELAY ACCESS.

At the center of the room, a glass signal core pulses with pale light. Every pulse broadcasts a different voice from the radio speakers: your team, Dr. Vale, your own voice, then a child laughing.
scenes.prompt: Destroying it may stop the signal, but it may also kill power to the bunker doors. What do you do?

options.label: Smash the core
options.response: I smash the signal core and stop the broadcast.

options.label: Overload the system
options.response: I overload the relay system from the control panel.

options.label: Open the hatch
options.response: I open the lower relay hatch to see what powers the signal.

scenes.title: Whiteout Escape
scenes.text:
You retreat into the storm. Behind you, the bunker door slams shut. The lights vanish.

You stumble back to the outpost just as the storm buries the trail. You survive the night, but the radio never stops whispering.

Days later, rescue arrives. When they ask what happened, you realize one of the rescuers has Dr. Vale’s voice.
scenes.endingSummary: You escaped, but the signal survived.

scenes.title: Thermal Scanner: Shapes in the Walls
scenes.text:
The thermal scanner shows no human heat signatures in the hall. Then the display glitches and outlines a huge shape wrapped around the bunker walls, as if the building itself has veins.

A smaller heat source appears in a side corridor, weak but alive. The scanner labels it: DR. M. VALE.
scenes.prompt: What do you do?

options.label: Find Dr. Vale
options.response: I follow the scanner toward Dr. Vale’s heat signature.

options.label: Go to the relay room
options.response: I avoid the heat source and head straight for the relay room.

scenes.title: Locked Inside
scenes.text:
You barricade the outpost doors and wait for rescue. For one hour, nothing happens. Then the radio begins broadcasting from inside the storage room.

The voice says, “You made the correct choice. Now stay where I can see you.”

The outpost lights flicker on one by one, though you shut them off. In the window reflection, someone stands behind you wearing your face.

scenes.title: Dr. Vale Changes
scenes.text:
You pull Dr. Vale from the maintenance grate. She can walk, but barely. As you move toward the relay room, she keeps repeating the emergency code under her breath.

Then she stops and asks, in your voice, “Do you think I copied enough?”

Her eyes clear again. “If I change, lock me in the relay room.”
scenes.prompt: You reach the relay door. What do you do?

options.label: Bring Dr. Vale
options.response: I bring Dr. Vale into the relay room with me.

options.label: Lock Dr. Vale in the corridor
options.response: I lock Dr. Vale in the corridor before entering the relay room.

scenes.title: Dark Victory
scenes.text:
You smash the signal core. The room goes black. The radio screams with hundreds of stolen voices, then dies.

The bunker power fails. The lower knocking stops. For a moment, there is only darkness and your breathing.

You force your way back through the half-open entrance door and collapse into the snow. The storm begins to clear.

When rescue arrives, the bunker is silent.
scenes.endingSummary: You stopped the signal and escaped.

scenes.title: Controlled Burn
scenes.text:
You overload the relay system. Warning lights flash red. The machines begin to burn from the inside, sending sparks across the floor.

Unlike smashing the core, the overload keeps the doors powered for three minutes. You sprint back through the bunker as the thing in the walls thrashes and howls.

You dive through the jammed entrance door just before the relay chamber explodes.

Behind you, the bunker seals itself forever.
scenes.endingSummary: You destroyed the relay and preserved containment.

scenes.title: Almost Human
scenes.text:
You bring Dr. Vale into the relay room. She helps you overload the system, moving with desperate speed.

Just as the relay begins to burn, she grabs your wrist. Her face flickers between Mara, you, and something unfinished.

“Lock me in,” she says. “Now.”

You hesitate for one second too long. The thing wearing her smiles.

It escapes with you into the storm.
scenes.endingSummary: The signal is destroyed, but something escaped.

scenes.title: The Hard Choice
scenes.text:
You lock Dr. Vale in the corridor. She pounds on the door once, then whispers, “Thank you.”

Inside the relay room, you overload the system. Fire spreads through the machines. The bunker shakes violently as the thing below realizes it has lost its voice.

You escape through the jammed entrance as the relay burns out behind you. Dr. Vale does not follow.

At dawn, the storm breaks. The radio is silent.
scenes.endingSummary: You saved the world, but not everyone.
